# ssp_recurring_backup_config (Resource)

Manages the automated (recurring) backup schedule for the SSP platform.

This is a singleton resource — only one recurring backup policy can exist per SSP instance.
Use `terraform import ssp_recurring_backup_config.this singleton` to adopt an existing policy.

Set `backup_schedule_type` to `WEEKLY` and populate `backup_schedule_weekly`, or set it to
`INTERVAL` and populate `backup_schedule_interval`.

Corresponds to `GET/PUT /ssp/backup/recurring/config`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_schedule_type` (String) Schedule type: `WEEKLY` (calendar days/time) or `INTERVAL` (hours between runs).
- `backup_type` (String) Backup scope. Must be `FULL_BACKUP`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) When `true`, automated backups run on the configured schedule.

### Optional

- `backup_schedule_interval` (Attributes) Interval schedule settings. Required when `backup_schedule_type = INTERVAL`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_schedule_interval))
- `backup_schedule_weekly` (Attributes) Weekly schedule settings. Required when `backup_schedule_type = WEEKLY`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_schedule_weekly))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `singleton` for this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--backup_schedule_interval"></a>

### Nested Schema for `backup_schedule_interval`

Optional:

- `hours_between_backups` (Number) Hours between consecutive automated backups (6–720). Defaults to `168` (weekly).

<a id="nestedatt--backup_schedule_weekly"></a>

### Nested Schema for `backup_schedule_weekly`

Required:

- `days_of_week` (List of String) Days of week when backup runs (e.g. `["MONDAY", "THURSDAY"]`).

Optional:

- `hour_of_day` (Number) Hour of day (0–23, UTC) when the backup starts. Defaults to `0`.
- `minute_of_day` (Number) Minute within the hour (0–59) when the backup starts. Defaults to `0`.
